sample_unit: unplanned potentially preventable hospital transfers (across 184 SNFs)
models_evaluated: contactless cardiorespiratory bedside monitor RPM service

links.outcome: Alert burden and predictive value of AI alerts reviewed by remote clinical team before on-site staff
links.effect: Remote team review preceded alerts to on-site staff; overall PPV 35.4%; 23.9 unique patients alerted per 100 beds per month, described as manageable alert burden.
links.quote: RPM using continuous, contactless cardiorespiratory monitoring enabled early identification of certain patient deterioration events with clinically meaningful sensitivity and lead time, and manageable alert burden, complementing standard care.

unlisted_practices: Remote clinical team review of continuous monitoring data with alerts to on-site staff for deterioration detection in skilled nursing facilities
Using an LLM classifier to identify on-site treated deterioration events for PPV estimation

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment performance (sensitivity, PPV, alert burden) of an AI-enabled remote patient monitoring service across 184 skilled nursing facilities, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
